title: Grateful Dead Live at Eureka Municipal Auditorium on 1968-01-20

ai_review.summary: Excellent Miller soundboard capture of a jazzy, swing‑filled set featuring the first Clementine, Spanish Jam and stellar Pigpen keyboards.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crystal‑clear Miller soundboard source that lets every instrument be heard with superb clarity. Musically the show is described as a rare, high‑energy performance with smooth transitions, highlighted by the debut of Clementine, a fiery Spanish Jam, New Potato and Born Cross‑Eyed, and an impressive Pigpen on keyboards.

ai_rating.rationale: Four out of five detailed reviews rate the show and recording at the highest level, noting exceptional musical moments and excellent sound quality; only one brief negative comment about missing track info does not outweigh the consensus.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Miller source praised as the best available, with crystal‑clear mix and full instrument separation; reviewers note “audio is excellent” and that you can hear every instrument.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Transitions described as smooth and effortless, with a jazzy swing feel that carries the set from one jam to the next.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for spacious New Potato guitar tone and lead vocals on Clementine.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted as writer of Clementine and cited for his Coltrane‑inspired influence; no specific bass performance comment.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen highlighted as being in top form on keyboards throughout the show.
